machine.name: Sewing machine
machine.why: Machine-sewn seams are strong and quick.

needle-90.name: Universal or denim needle 90/14
needle-90.why: Thick fabrics need a sturdier needle.

needle-ball.name: Ballpoint / stretch needle 75/11
needle-ball.why: Slides between knit loops instead of cutting them.

rotary.name: Rotary cutter, mat & quilting ruler
rotary.why: Fast, precise straight cuts — best for many squares or strips.

pins.name: Pins or sewing clips
pins.why: Holding layers together while you sew.

clips.name: Sewing clips
clips.why: Hold thick layers without distorting them.

safety-pin.name: Safety pin or bodkin
safety-pin.why: Threading elastic or cord through a channel.

zip-foot.name: Zipper foot
zip-foot.why: Stitches right next to zipper teeth.

walking-foot.name: Walking foot
walking-foot.why: Feeds thick quilt layers evenly so they don't shift.
substitutes: Standard foot, sewn slowly with lots of pins

seam-gauge.name: Seam gauge
substitutes: Card strip marked with the measurement

pressing-cloth.name: Pressing cloth
pressing-cloth.why: Protects fabric and iron when fusing.
